title: Helen Britton: The Story So Far at MPRG
summary: Living Treasures exhibition celebrating eminent Australian craft. Helen Britton's The Story So Far traces creativity and country women through painting, installation, jewellery, drawings and photography. Free entry. On loan from Australian Design Centre, Sydney.
recurrenceNote: Open Sat–Sun 11am–4pm (check MPRG for weekday hours)
suitableFor: Adults, families, art lovers, gallery visitors
nearbyAttractions: Mornington foreshore; Main Street cafes; Mornington Pier
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with lunch on Main Street Mornington and a walk along the foreshore
editorVerdict: A touring exhibition on loan from the Australian Design Centre in Sydney. Here it's free and you can park without a headache.
editorNote:
Helen Britton is one of Australia's most celebrated contemporary craft artists — this retrospective traces her career through painting, jewellery, installation and photography. It's on loan from the Australian Design Centre in Sydney where it was a major drawcard.

MPRG gets it for the winter run at no cost to you. Open Saturday and Sunday 11am–4pm as a minimum; check their website for weekday hours.

Pair with the companion exhibition next door — Natalia Milosz-Piekarska: Sifted Light — both are on the same footprint. Mornington Main Street is five minutes on foot for lunch afterwards.
